steps.eval: (G.save.flags.taught = { city_in: true, city_drive: true, city_map: true }, JSON.stringify(['cash','bottle','rounds'].map((k) => [k, Math.round(Math.min(...G.stage.part('items').list.filter((q) => q.kind === k).map((q) => Math.hypot(q.x + 112.2, q.z - 30))))])))
steps.label: the nearest of each kind from the start (m)
